# Discover Assynt

ABOUT

Assynt is a small parish of just over one thousand people tucked away in the far North Western corner of Scotland. It is bounded on four corners by the Point of Stoer, Kylesku, Elphin and Inverkirkaig.

​

The village of Lochinver is our largest settlement and home to almost 400 people. The remainder of our population live and work around the coastal townships of Inverkirkaig, Achmelvich, Clachtoll, Stoer, Clashnessie, Drumbeg and Kylesku. Inchnadamph and Elphin are settled amidst the geological wonders of the Moine thrust and Loch Assynt.

​

Our remarkable landscape and mountains are immortalised by the pen of Norman MacCaig who enquired:

​

Who possesses this landscape?

The man who bought it or

I who am possessed by it?

Come visit, slow down, breathe and discover this most hidden

part of Scotland for yourself.

Situated on the north west coast of Scotland 25 miles north of Ullapool in Wester Ross, the villages of Achiltibuie, Achnahaird, Reiff, Altandhu, Polbain, Polglass, Badenscallie and Culnacraig all lie in Coigach. The resident population is around 250.

Coigach lies within the North West Highlands Geopark, the Wester Ross Marine Protected Area, the Coigach Assynt National Scenic Area and the Wester Ross Biosphere Reserve. A lot of people think it’s something special, but don’t take their word for it judge for yourself.

Download our current leaflet to help you plan your visit. [Achiltibuie Leaflet 2023](https://visitcoigach.com/download/4231/?tmstv=1794768377 "") (1.7 Mb) This includes a map and ideas for what to see and do in the area.
